scene_analysis.scene_overview: A white wall with a black plaque and two silver hooks mounted on it. The plaque has a hole in the middle and text written in white. There is a white switch below the plaque. To the right of the plaque is a white towel rack with a white towel hanging on it. The floor is made of dark brown tiles. A white light fixture is mounted on the wall to the left of the plaque. The wall is painted white and there is a dark brown section at the bottom.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building is cream colored with stone quoins at the corners. It is tall and narrow. The top half of the building is made of red brick. The bottom half is made of polished granite. The building is well maintained.
scene_analysis.materials: The plaque is made of metal. The hook is also made of metal. The towel rack is made of metal. The towel is made of cotton.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There is a bench on the left side of the plaque. There is a lamp post on the right side of the plaque. There is a trash can on the right side of the plaque. There is a bike rack on the right side of the plaque.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are no plants or trees visible.
scene_analysis.signage: There is a sign on the wall to the right of the plaque. The sign is rectangular and made of metal. It has a hole in the middle.
